newsitem.title: ITALY: Maximum rate 7.59 pct at Italy BOT sale.
newsitem.headline: Maximum rate 7.59 pct at Italy BOT sale.

text.p: The maximum rate at today's 3.75 trillion lire sale of short term Treasury bills (BOTs) by the Bank of Italy was 7.59 percent compared with 7.84 percent previously, the Bank said.
The average rate was 7.51 percent also against 7.81 percent at the previous operation for 1.5 trillion lire on October 23.
The Bank said it received 16 bids of which six were met in full and one in part.
